title: SkyLite (Member Edition)
description: The official modpack for the SkyLite Network
body:
# **Description :**
The official **_SkyLite Network_** modpack, with simple game-optimizing features and light-weight mods that also allows you to create blueprints in worlds, improve your FPS, add game enhancements like _Fullbright_, and that also let you play with friends on private worlds, basically a modpack for **_everyone_**!
